          He looks to the throng of press swarming like vultures around
          Gatsby's casket. Seized by fury, he snaps and screams as he
          advances down the stairs!

elements.name: b
elements.content: GET OUT! ALL OF YOU OUT! GET

elements.name: b
elements.content: INT. GATSBY'S CASTLE - GRAND BALLROOM - NIGHT

Time has passed. Nick sits on the steps slouched against the
          rail. He looks down to Gatsby's still face, sad, alone...
I rang, I wrote, I implored...

elements.name: b
elements.content: THE CAMERA PUSHES SLOWLY DOWN TOWARD GATSBY:

But not a single one of the
                    sparkling hundreds who had enjoyed
                    his hospitality all summer,
                    attended the funeral...
                         
          ECU: Gatsby.

And from Daisy, not even a flower.
                         
          Distraught and exhausted, Nick's eyes slowly close...

I was all he had; the only one who
                    cared...

elements.name: b
elements.content: INT. SANITARIUM - DOCTOR'S OFFICE - SUMMER - MORNING

Nick is sound asleep on the couch, his typewriter and dozens
          of type-filled pages in front of him. Clearly, he has been
          writing all night...
                         
          The Doctor enters. He looks tenderly to Nick, and picks up a
          loose page from the floor...

Its winter now.
                         
          The city is blanketed by an unforgiving, cold grey sky...

After Gatsby's death, New York was
                    haunted for me...
                         
          DISCOVER: Nick, a tumult of anger, grief and despair,
          wandering unshaven through a Fifth Avenue crowd...

That city... My once golden...
                    shimmering mirage, now made me
                    sick.

elements.name: b
elements.content: EXT. GATSBY'S CASTLE - FRONT GATES - EVENING
DRIFT TOWARD: Gatsby's castle, ghostly in the moonlight.

On my last night in New York... I
                    returned to that huge, incoherent
                    house once more.

Very drunk, Nick trails over broken relics of lost grandeur,
          through rooms that have been stripped...

Wolfsheim's 'associates' had
                    cleaned the place out...
                         
          ALL AROUND NICK: Ghostly images from Nick's memory - from all
          those glittering parties, haunting snatches of music,
          laughter and conversation, imagery - mixing and FADING IN AND

He threw all those parties hoping
                    she would wander in one night...
But how do you live her all alone?

She makes it look so splendid,
                    don't you think, old sport?

Music! And then we can dance all
                    night...

Will you come old sport? We... need
                    you.

I wish it could always be like
                    this...
Nick wanders out as a light rain beings to fall.

I remembered how we had all come to
                    Gatsby's, and guessed at his
                    corruption... While he had stood
                    before us concealing an
                    incorruptible dream...
                         
          A FINAL MEMORY: Gatsby and Daisy together on the dance-
          floor... Daisy leans in and whispers happily to Gatsby...

Its perfect... From your perfect,
                    irresistible imagination.
Nick stumbles along the dock; the rain falling steadily now.

The moon rose higher... And as I
                    stood there, brooding on the old,
                    unknown world, I thought of
                    Gatsby's wonder when he first
                    picked out the green light at the
                    end of Daisy's dock.
                         
          Nick looks to the end of the dock, where he first saw Gatsby
          that warm summer night...

He had come such a long way...
                         
          And suddenly, shimmering ghostly through the rain, Gatsby's
          silhouette can be seen once more, gazing out across the bay.

And his dream must have seemed so
                    close that he could hardly fail to
                    grasp it.
                         
          Gatsby turns back towards Nick, and smiles...

He did not know that it was already
                      behind him...
                         
          Nick smiles back.

Gatsby believed in the green light,
                      the orgastic future that year by
                      year, recedes before us...
                         
          PUSH PAST GATSBY: Out over the water, toward the green light
          eternally pulsing at the end of Daisy's dock...

It eluded us then, but that's no
                      matter - tomorrow we will run
                      faster...
                         
          Gatsby reaches out--

Stretch out our arms farther... And
                      one fine morning...
                         
          As we PUSH PAST Gatbsy's outstretched hand, THE OPENING IMAGE
          RETURNS: The green light pulsing in the abstract dark...
                         
          Nick's final words appear as TYPE ON THE SCREEN.

So we beat on, boats against the
                      current, borne back ceaselessly,
                      into the past.

elements.name: b
elements.content: INT. SANTITARIUM - NICK'S ROOM - SUMMER - DAY

Nick pulls a final page from his typewriter, sets the page on
          top of his completed manuscript and we clearly see the title:
